name: Ningbo Cixing Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Cixing Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of knitting machinery in China and internationally. It operates through Flat Knitting Machine Business, Mobile Internet Business, Automation Equipment and Project Integration Business, and Other Businesses segments. The company offers intelligent knitting machinery and equipment; flat knitting machines, steiger, circular machines, and other smart knitting equipment; and computerized shoe machines, automated shoe-making production lines, automatic ironing machines, and industrial robots.
